name: Honda CR125R
engine: 123 cc two-stroke single, air-cooled then liquid-cooled, carb, premix
intro: Honda's 125 motocross two-stroke. Premix, a top end that needs regular rebuilds, and a power valve on later years.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Honda dealer to run the VIN as well.
